clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
By virtue of and pursuant to the au­
thority vested in me by Title n  of the 
Second War Powers Act, 1942 (56 Stat. 
177) as amended, the National Advisory 
Committee for Aeronautics is hereby 
authorized to exercise the authority con­
tained in the said Title n  of the Second 
War Powers Act, 1942, to acquire, use, 
and dispose of any real property, tempo­
rary use thereof, or other interest 
therein, together with any personal prop­
erty located thereon, or used therewith, 
which the National Advisory Committee 
for Aeronautics shall deem necessary for 
military, naval, or other war purposes.
